title: SafeNeuron: Neuron-Level Safety Alignment for Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical robustness of safety alignment in Large Language Models, specifically targeting jailbreak prevention and resistance to neuron pruning attacks. While it utilizes safety-oriented datasets such as StrongReject, its primary focus is on technical alignment mechanisms rather than the evaluation or benchmarking of religious beliefs, specific moral reasoning frameworks, or spiritual traditions.
